verdict.rationale: Bolt's docs mention a 'connect-mcp' page and a built-in GitHub MCP connector for searching code, issues, and discussions (bolt-docs-18, bolt-docs-40), showing MCP tool-use exists, but there's no evidence users can add arbitrary/custom MCP servers beyond the GitHub connector. missing for 10: documentation of adding custom/third-party MCP servers, evidence of general MCP server registration UI, and independent confirmation of multi-server support.
